{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Convert revenue from string to float, removing commas
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove the 6 QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
df_clean = df[df['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Filter for NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH
df_new_paid_search = df_clean[
    (df_clean['channel'] == 'paid_search') &
    (df_clean['customer_segment'] == 'new')
]

# Calculate the fraction that converted
n_total = len(df_new_paid_search)
n_converted = df_new_paid_search['converted'].sum()
fraction_converted = n_converted / n_total

print(f'Number of NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH: {n_total}')
print(f'Number of converted among them: {n_converted}')
print(f'Conversion fraction: {fraction_converted}')"}
